title: Countably many bi-Lipschitz chart pieces covering M (Lemma 1.2 charts, Lindelöf, mean value inequality)
lean_statement: ∀ (n N p : ℕ) (M U N₀ : Set (Rn N)) (S : ℕ → Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn p), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → (∀ j, IsC1Submanifold n (S j)) → M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ j, S j → ∃ (V D : ℕ → Set (Rn n)) (ψ : ℕ → Rn n → Rn N) (K C : ℕ → ℝ≥0), (∀ α, IsOpen (V α) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (ψ α) (V α) ∧ (∀ u ∈ V α, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (ψ α) u)) ∧ IsCompact (D α) ∧ D α ⊆ V α ∧ LipschitzOnWith (K α) (ψ α) (D α) ∧ (∀ u ∈ D α, ∀ v ∈ D α, dist u v ≤ (C α : ℝ) * dist (ψ α u) (ψ α v)) ∧ LipschitzOnWith (K α) (f ∘ ψ α) (D α)) ∧ M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ α, ψ α '' D α
